title: MemeGuard: An LLM and VLM-based Framework for Advancing Content Moderation via Meme Intervention

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the framework's ability to identify gender stereotypes in memes (e.g., associating women with household chores) and generating appropriate counter-speech interventions, assessed via automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore) and human evaluation (fluency, adequacy, persuasiveness).

Assessing the quality of generated interventions against xenophobic or racist memes (e.g., anti-immigrant content) using automated similarity metrics and human evaluation, alongside topic modeling of the generated responses.

Testing the model's capability to generate relevant interventions for memes that mock physical abilities or appearances, evaluated qualitatively through case studies and quantitatively as part of the overall cyberbullying dataset.

Included as a specific category of toxic elements in the dataset's annotation guidelines, with the overall intervention generation framework evaluated on its ability to counter these hateful concepts.
